About Pure Trader

Your Trusted Partner in Pest Control

Pure Trader is a pest control service provider based in Faisalabad, Pakistan, established in 1988.

Under the leadership of Muhammad Afzal, M.Sc. Agriculture, we provide pest control and management services for residential and commercial properties.

Our mission is to help protect homes, businesses and properties from unwanted pests through professional service and responsible treatment practices.
